channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 06
item.description:
113 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed inconsistent NPC agent velocity and speed spikes, improving movement reliability.
  • Adjusted boar flee behavior: lowered health threshold from 75% to 30%.
  • Fixed cow pathing to prevent clipping and improved feeding at troughs and grass.

Character Customization

  • Resolved several character creator issues: fading, stray prompts, limited skin tones, teleport glitch when opening the menu, and lighting after reconnect.

Controls & UI

  • Moved crafting action to D‑pad down across all control schemes.
  • Fixed key suppression timing bug, improving input responsiveness.
  • Run toggle now persists correctly between movement sprints.
  • Fixed menu drift caused by deadzone handling.

Map & Markers

  • Restored deep‑sea monument markers and fixed shop marker cache corruption on disconnect/reconnect.

Weapons & Tools

  • Bee grenade no longer appears white when throw prediction is enabled.
  • Helicopter flares now work correctly after saving/loading, ensuring functional flare deployment.

Stability

  • Fixed NaN vertex lighting issue that could cause crashes.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 05
item.description:
84 development commits

World & Locations

  • Fixed broken S2P apartments, bandit bases, and fishing villages so they now spawn correctly.

UI & Localization

  • Item drop and pickup notices now display correctly for right‑to‑left languages.
  • Crafting notices are now rendered with RustText, fixing RTL language display and eliminating per‑frame allocation spikes.

Gameplay & Mechanics

  • Softcore servers now enforce a maximum of three Tool Cupboards per base, with UI icons and toast notifications when the limit is reached.

Combat & Projectiles

  • Fixed a bug where projectiles could leak and persist after the owning player was destroyed.

Power & Generators

  • Biofuel generators now only consume electricity while actively generating fuel, reducing idle power drain.

Livestock

  • Fixed livestock age regression and variance errors, ensuring calves correctly age into adults and maintain accurate ages.
  • Increased the lead rope break distance from 7 m to 15 m and now display livestock familiarity and gender by default.
  • Raised the sale penalty for selling bought or found animals to the livestock vendor from 0.2 to 0.85, making it harder to profit from such sales.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Fixed motorcycle dismount order issue, ensuring players dismount safely and predictably.
  • Corrected client-side sailing wind calculations, improving sail handling and navigation accuracy.

Character Customisation

  • Introduced a revamped character creator layout for easier navigation of customization options.
  • Added an underwear customization category, expanding player outfit choices.
  • Removed the eyebrows category, streamlining available facial features.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Oct 04
item.description:
13 development commits

Softcore Mode

  • Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.

Research & Crafting

  • Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.

Farming & Food

  • Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.

Vehicles

  • Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.
